messages.subject: Re: Return /Refund Policy
messages.text:
Hello Michael,
 

 Sorry for the longer than usual response time.
 

 Here is the exchange procedure:
 

 PART 1: ON YOUR SIDE 
 

 1. Pay the exchange fee of $9.99 via the following link: https://lasclay.com/products/echange-grandeur
 

 Choose the desired size. Note: An exchange costs us about $26 for 2 round-trip packages. Therefore, we ask the customer to cover about 38% of this cost. 
 

 PART 2: ON OUR SIDE 
 

 1. We will send you a new pair to the same address as your initial order.
 

 2. Included in the envelope will be a return slip, which will allow you to put the first pair of mittens in the same envelope, stick the new label over the old one, and seal it. You can keep the milkweed seeds and the postcard. Please do not use a box, use the same envelope. 
 

 PART 3: ON YOUR SIDE 
 

 1. Take the envelope with the contents and swapped return labels and place it in a Canada Post red box, or at the post office.
 

 2. \IMPORTANT\ : To notify us that your return has been made and help us close the file, it would be appreciated if you could send us photos of the return (e.g., photos of the package in front of a red mailbox, or at the post office).
 

 That's it, simple as that! We trust our customers, which is why we send the new pair quickly before receiving the first one. To honor this courtesy on our part, we ask that you please return your items as soon as possible.
 

 We look forward to hearing from you 😊
 

 Warmly,
 __
 Abygael 
 Customer Service 
 Lasclay

messages.subject: Re: Return /Refund Policy
messages.text:
Hello Michael,
 

 Unfortunately we can only grant an exchange, as your first email was after 22 days when our return policy / satisfaction warranty lasts 15 days. Out of respect for our other customers, we must rigorously apply our policies.
 

 We attached to this email a UPS return label and customs form. You must print both and put them visibly on the envelope in which you will put the mittens you wish to return. Upon reception we will ship your new pair.
 

 Warmly,
 __
 Gabriel 
 Co-founder 
 Lasclay
